content.text:
All 5 cold-start iterations complete — each run force-stopped the process (`terminate_app`), returned to the home screen, then timed the `launch_app` call until the app's home screen (Catalog/Form/About/Checkout) was confirmed rendered via screenshot. Device: Pixel 8 Pro (Android 16), package `dev.lincforge.benchtarget`.

**Cold-start measurements (5 runs):**

| Run | Time (ms) |
|---|---|
| 1 | 5031 |
| 2 | 4422 |
| 3 | 4498 |
| 4 | 4754 |
| 5 | 4819 |

**Summary statistics:**
- **Median:** 4754 ms
- **Mean:** 4704.8 ms
- **Standard deviation:** ≈221.2 ms (population, ÷n) / ≈247.3 ms (sample, ÷n-1)
- **Variance:** ≈48,918 ms² (population) / ≈61,148 ms² (sample)

Note on methodology: since the available device-control tools don't expose `am start -W`/logcat-level timing, each measurement is the wall-clock delta between issuing the launch command and visually confirming the app's UI was fully rendered — this includes tool round-trip overhead on top of the device's actual process-start time, so treat these as an upper-bound/black-box estimate of true cold start rather than a kernel-level `TotalTime` figure.
